content: qrcode (node-qrcode) npm package v1.5.4 is the standard, most battle-tested QR generator for Node — supports PNG (via node-canvas or built-in raster), SVG string output, terminal, data URL. errorCorrectionLevel 'H' tolerates ~30% data loss, needed when overlaying a logo. Library does not natively composite logos — standard pattern is to render the QR (PNG buffer or canvas) then overlay a logo image on top using 'sharp' (recommended, no native canvas/jsdom dependency issues) or 'canvas'/'jimp'; keep logo <=30% of QR area to preserve scannability at level H. For SVG output with logo, embed the logo as an <image> element inside the generated SVG markup. Alternative 'qr-code-styling' supports rounded modules + logo out of the box but requires canvas+jsdom in Node (heavier server-side dependency).
